convert.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another using the latest rate, or the rate as of a past date.
convert.name: convert

parameters.description: Currency to convert from, as a 3-letter ISO code.
parameters.name: base

parameters.description: Currency to convert to, as a 3-letter ISO code.
parameters.name: quote

parameters.description: The amount, in the base currency, to convert.
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: Optional date whose rate to use, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the latest rate.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Comma-separated provider keys to source the rate from (for example, ECB). Leave blank for the default blended rate.
parameters.name: providers

get_coverage.description: Find the first and last dates for which rates exist for a base currency, optionally narrowed to particular quote currencies or providers. Use it to pick a valid date range before fetching a time series or historical rates.
get_coverage.name: get_coverage

parameters.description: Base currency as a 3-letter ISO code (for example, EUR). Defaults to USD when omitted.
parameters.name: base

parameters.description: Comma-separated quote currencies the coverage must include (for example, GBP,JPY). Leave blank for the base currency's overall coverage.
parameters.name: quotes

parameters.description: Comma-separated provider keys to restrict the coverage to (for example, ECB). Leave blank for all providers.
parameters.name: providers

get_currency.description: Get the details and provider coverage for a single currency by its ISO code.
get_currency.name: get_currency

parameters.description: The currency's 3-letter ISO code (for example, EUR).
parameters.name: code

get_historical_rates.description: Look up exchange rates for a specific past date (rates are available back to 1948).
get_historical_rates.name: get_historical_rates

parameters.description: The date to look up, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Base currency as a 3-letter ISO code (for example, EUR). Defaults to USD when omitted.
parameters.name: base

parameters.description: Comma-separated target currencies to return (for example, USD,GBP). Leave blank for every available currency.
parameters.name: quotes

parameters.description: Comma-separated provider keys to source rates from (for example, ECB). Leave blank to use the default blended rates.
parameters.name: providers

parameters.description: Set to true to include, on each rate, the list of providers that contributed to the blended value.
parameters.name: expand_providers

get_latest_rates.description: Fetch the most recent exchange rates. Optionally change the base currency, filter the target currencies, or scope to specific providers.
get_latest_rates.name: get_latest_rates

parameters.description: Base currency as a 3-letter ISO code (for example, EUR). Defaults to USD when omitted.
parameters.name: base

parameters.description: Comma-separated target currencies to return (for example, USD,GBP). Leave blank for every available currency.
parameters.name: quotes

parameters.description: Comma-separated provider keys to source rates from (for example, ECB). Leave blank to use the default blended rates.
parameters.name: providers

parameters.description: Set to true to include, on each rate, the list of providers that contributed to the blended value.
parameters.name: expand_providers

get_provider.description: Get one central bank or official source by its key: its name, country, rate type, pivot currency, publishing cadence, the dates it covers, and every currency it publishes.
get_provider.name: get_provider

parameters.description: The provider's key as listed by List providers (for example, ECB for the European Central Bank or UST for the U.S. Treasury).
parameters.name: key

get_provider_rate.description: Get one provider's published rate for a single currency pair, optionally as of a past date.
get_provider_rate.display_str_template: Get the {1} to {2} rate from provider {0}.
get_provider_rate.name: get_provider_rate

parameters.description: The provider's key as listed by List providers (for example, ECB for the European Central Bank or UST for the U.S. Treasury).
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: Base currency as a 3-letter ISO code (for example, EUR).
parameters.name: base

parameters.description: Quote currency as a 3-letter ISO code (for example, USD).
parameters.name: quote

parameters.description: Optional date to price the pair as of, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the provider's latest rate.
parameters.name: date

get_provider_rates.description: Fetch the rates one provider published, unblended: the latest by default, a single past day with a date, or a series with a start date (and optional end date and weekly or monthly grouping). Use this for compliance or accounting work that must cite a specific central bank's reference rate.
get_provider_rates.name: get_provider_rates

parameters.description: The provider's key as listed by List providers (for example, ECB for the European Central Bank or UST for the U.S. Treasury).
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: A single day to look up, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank, along with the start date, for the latest rates. Cannot be combined with a start or end date.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: The first date of a range, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Set this instead of a single date to get a time series.
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: The last date of the range, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank to run through the latest available date.
parameters.name: to_date

parameters.description: Base currency as a 3-letter ISO code (for example, EUR). Defaults to USD when omitted.
parameters.name: base

parameters.description: Comma-separated target currencies to return (for example, USD,GBP). Leave blank for every available currency.
parameters.name: quotes

parameters.description: Downsample a range to one row per week or per month.
parameters.name: group

parameters.description: Set to true to include, on each rate, the list of providers that contributed to the blended value.
parameters.name: expand_providers

get_rate.description: Get the exchange rate for a single currency pair, optionally as of a past date.
get_rate.name: get_rate

parameters.description: Base currency as a 3-letter ISO code (for example, EUR).
parameters.name: base

parameters.description: Quote currency as a 3-letter ISO code (for example, USD).
parameters.name: quote

parameters.description: Optional date to price the pair as of, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the latest rate.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Comma-separated provider keys to source the rate from (for example, ECB). Leave blank for the default blended rate.
parameters.name: providers

get_time_series.description: Fetch exchange rates across a date range. Optionally downsample to weekly or monthly buckets to keep large ranges compact.
get_time_series.name: get_time_series

parameters.description: The first date of the range, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: The last date of the range, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank to run through the latest available date.
parameters.name: to_date

parameters.description: Base currency as a 3-letter ISO code (for example, EUR). Defaults to USD when omitted.
parameters.name: base

parameters.description: Comma-separated target currencies to return (for example, USD,GBP). Leave blank for every available currency.
parameters.name: quotes

parameters.description: Downsample the series to one row per week or per month.
parameters.name: group

parameters.description: Comma-separated provider keys to source rates from (for example, ECB). Leave blank to use the default blended rates.
parameters.name: providers

parameters.description: Set to true to include, on each rate, the list of providers that contributed to the blended value.
parameters.name: expand_providers

list_currencies.description: List the available currencies with their ISO codes, names, and symbols. Optionally include legacy currencies.
list_currencies.name: list_currencies

parameters.description: Whether to return only active currencies (default) or to also include legacy ones.
parameters.name: scope

parameters.description: Comma-separated provider keys (for example, ECB). When set, only currencies those providers publish are returned.
parameters.name: providers

list_providers.description: List the central-bank data sources behind the API, with their keys, names, and rate types.
list_providers.name: list_providers

description: Fetch foreign-exchange rates and currency data through Frankfurter's keyless API: latest and historical rates, time series, single-pair lookups, currency conversion, date coverage, the list of currencies, and the central-bank providers behind the rates, including each provider's own unblended rates. Over 220 currencies are tracked from more than 100 central banks and official sources, back to 1948. No account or API key required.
